title: Jelly's Biloxi godparents
summary: What she knows of his godmother in Biloxi and Alabama and her possible names.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, the only thing when I can say anything concrete is when he moved to Biloxi, and everybody knew that he was there, and in Alabama, and things like that. But I don't know anything about— That was with his godmother over there. With his godmother and godfather over there. Sometimes he spoke of her name as Bing Echo. Had that been her—
Echo? E-C-H-O. Was this—that might have been her maiden name before she was married. But her name was Lally. You should call her Lally. Yes. Uh-huh. Yes. And he doesn't call her that.
To get—then you—the other children that your mother had weren't—didn't live to—
No. Be— No. To be named, I don't think.
Yes. They didn't live long enough to be named.
